quote: a token-by-token table is overkill. one sentence then an example
rule: Explain regexes with one sentence and an example.

quote: commit messages here are conventional commits, fix(auth): ..., not 'Fixed stuff with login'.
rule: Use conventional commit format for commit messages.

quote: don't use real celebrity names in demo data, use obviously fake ones
rule: Use clearly fictional names in demo data.

quote: bullets, not an essay. 5 lines max
rule: Keep status updates to a few short bullets.

quote: times need the timezone written out. '10pm' on its own confuses the Berlin folks
rule: Always state the timezone alongside times in announcements.

quote: we follow keep a changelog, newest on top under ## [Unreleased]. you put it at the bottom
rule: Add changelog entries under Unreleased at the top.

quote: I asked yes or no. one line is fine.
rule: Answer yes/no questions in one line.

quote: don't reach for redis for an in-process lookup table. a Map is fine
rule: Prefer in-process structures before adding external services.

quote: please don't pull in moment for this, it's deprecated. date-fns or Intl
rule: Avoid moment.js; prefer date-fns or native Intl.

quote: user-facing errors shouldn't blame them. 'You did something wrong' is bad, 'Your session expired, please sign in again' is fine
rule: Phrase user-facing errors neutrally, without blaming the user.

quote: you keep apologizing. no need, just tell me what broke
rule: Skip apologies; state the problem directly.

quote: 9am for whom? you assumed UTC. our users are in Seoul, use Asia/Seoul unless I say otherwise
rule: Default to Asia/Seoul for user-facing schedules unless told otherwise.

quote: we use pnpm, not npm. you generated a package-lock.json again
rule: Use pnpm for package management in this repo.

quote: Node 18+ has fetch built in. no need for axios in a 40-line script
rule: Use built-in fetch instead of adding HTTP libraries to small scripts.

quote: use the pino logger we already have, not console.log with string concatenation
rule: Use the project's existing logger instead of console.log.

quote: way too long. three paragraphs of background before the actual answer. lead with the cause
rule: Lead with the answer and keep explanations short.

quote: I'm on macOS. find -printf doesn't exist on BSD find. give me something that works here
rule: Write shell commands compatible with macOS/BSD tools.

quote: Less cheerleading please. Skip the 'Great job!' and just list the problems.
rule: Give reviews without praise filler; list issues directly.

quote: use KB = 1024 like the rest of the UI, mixing 1000 and 1024 is confusing
rule: Use 1024-based units for file sizes to match the UI.

quote: too formal, reads like a press release. we're a four person team, write like a human
rule: Write release notes in a casual, plain voice.

quote: names like a, b, tmp2 are unreadable. name them for what they hold
rule: Use descriptive variable names, not single letters or tmpN.

quote: don't just assume it's permissions. give me the 2-3 likely causes, ranked
rule: Offer ranked likely causes instead of jumping to one assumption.

quote: we're on vitest, not jest. the config is sitting right there in the repo
rule: Use vitest for new tests.

quote: comments should be in English, not everyone on the team reads Korean
rule: Write code comments in English.

quote: please don't @mention people in PR descriptions, it pings them all
rule: Don't @mention people in generated PR descriptions.

quote: you explained how the flag system works like I'm new here. I wrote it. just give me the flag name
rule: Don't over-explain things the user already knows.

quote: 'last month' means the calendar month, not the last 30 days. we've been through this
rule: Interpret 'last month' as the previous calendar month.

quote: no emojis in summaries pls. plain text
rule: No emojis in summaries or reports.

quote: american spelling please, behavior not behaviour, the rest of the docs use it
rule: Use American English spelling in docs.

quote: YYYY-MM-DD everywhere please. no 03/04/24, nobody knows if thats march or april
rule: Use ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates in UI and output.
